issues.body_excerpt: If you are a beginner to SymPy please avoid posting to the mailing list unless you have a very good reason to and have put a lot of thought into whatever you're going to say. And alternative place you can discuss things is the new contributor's channel in [SymPy's Zulip](https://sympy.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/641746-new-contributors/topic//with/629429926). before_you_comment: Read the whole thread and any linked PRs first.
Reproduce the problem locally (or confirm the docs gap) before claiming.
Point to the code you would change and outline your approach in 2-3 sentences.
Ask whether the approach fits; do not just write 'can I work on this?'.
If someone claimed it recently, pick another issue rather than competing.
